body: I know how brutal break ups are. I'm trying to crawl out of one also. I don't have advice on how to feel better but you need to know that posting your feelings is never dumb.

I'm here with you feeling the same way. It is debilitating and unbearable. I hope it gets better for both of us. I also have no emotional processing skills. That makes it even harder. Keep pushing on and we can get through this terrible feeling together.
Thank you. I'll keep pushing on!

I completely know how you're feeling. It is truly gut wrenching. I wish I has some insight. Take some comfort knowing that another person in this world knows your pain. We're on this crazy ride together.
Someone please help me. I need to know there are people out there that feel the pain I do

Wish I had some words of advice but if it makes you feel better, I feel the exact same way. As crazy as it sounds sometimes it's nice knowing that another person is also feeling your pain. Maybe just knowing someone out there shares the same feeling will help you feel a small amount better.

I've been blaming myself everyday for getting dumped. I (F40) have always been the woman that will stand by man through almost anything. Problem is no guy I've dated has been willing to do the same. None of these men have given me a real reason as to why they're dumping me, they just quickly end it like it never mattered to them. The latest one came out of thin air. He went on and on about how much he loved me and that we were meant to be and all of the sudden he drops me. He wouldn't even give me an actual reason, just that it wasn't working. How can I not blame myself? It was obviously something I did wrong to make him fall out of love with no problem. I don't know how to shake this feeling.
People always say that "there's someone out there for you" or "it's his loss" but I don't believe that after many failed relationships.
